content:
Hello everyone!

I'm a software engineer from Utah with a passion for mathematics, especially formal methods and the intersection of mathematics and computer science. While my background is more industry-oriented than academic, I have always had a passion for working through deep problems and strengthening my mathematical intuition. Most of my knowledge comes from self-study, and I feel a bit intimidated by all the high-level math going on here, but I love to learn and hope to eventually feel comfortable here.
I have learned Coq in my free time several years ago, and studied and used Lean off and on for the past couple years. So far, I've gone through the Mathematics in Lean book and formalized a small equivalence which I figured out related to the Erdős–Straus conjecture. In addition, for the past several months, I've been working on a card game engine based on Magic: the Gathering, with a focus on performance alongside strong, formally verified properties.
I've been quite secretive in the past, working on all this stuff by myself, but recently realized that I should connect with others with similar interests. I want to transition my career path closer to my personal interests, and I think posting here might just be the first step on my journey. I'm excited to learn from this community and hope I can contribute to the Lean project and to help others here.
